texts.zh:
以太相引擎已经在虚境的薄幕上撕开了一个巨大的洞口。尽管洞口尚不够大到让我们颠覆整个领域，但是裂口已经激发了虚境各种存在的一系列活动。

它们最终意识到了我们的威胁，但是没有作出任何实质行动。引擎的卷须已经深深地嵌入到虚境内部，现在已经无法切断了。

我们已经很接近了。非常接近。
texts.en:
The Aetherophasic Engine has ripped a massive hole in the fabric of the Shroud. It is not yet large enough for us to fully subvert the realm, but the rupture has spurred a lot of activity among the Shroud entities.

They have finally recognized the threat we pose, but their efforts will amount to nothing. The tendrils of the Engine are embedded too deeply in the Shroud to be severed now.

We are close now. So very close.

label.zh: 没有什么能够阻止我们。

title.en: The Dying Gasps of the Shroud

texts.zh: 随着位于[From.GetName]的以太相引擎即将完工，虚境被迅速地改造成了某种……迥乎不同的事物。居住在其中的灵体陷入了彻底的狂暴，其中的一大波存在凿穿了通往我们现实的隧道，绝望地想要逃离这个地方。
texts.en: With the [From.GetName] having nearly completed their Aetherophasic Engine, the Shroud is rapidly transforming into something... different. The spirits who reside there are in an absolute frenzy, and another wave of them have tunneled into our reality in a desperate attempt to escape.

texts.zh: 随着以太相引擎即将完工，我们操纵虚境的能力极大地提升了。居住在其中的灵体陷入了彻底的狂暴，其中的一大波存在凿穿了通往我们现实的隧道，绝望地想要阻挠我们的计划。
texts.en: As the Aetherophasic Engine nears completion, our ability to manipulate the Shroud is rapidly increasing. The spirits who reside there are in an absolute frenzy, and another wave of them have tunneled into our reality in a desperate attempt to thwart our efforts.

label.en: We are running out of time...

label.zh: 他们在这里可找不到安宁。
label.en: They will find no solace here.

texts.zh:
位于[From.GetName]几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对拥有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若是特殊情况，还可能致命……
texts.en:
The nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine in the [From.GetName] is putting a terrible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely painful to most psionically-gifted sapients. In some cases, they can even be fatal...

texts.en:
The nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine in the [From.GetName] is putting a terrible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are likely to cause extreme pain to any psionic lifeform. Even our own collective may not be able to emerge unscathed from such a phenomenon.

texts.zh:
我们几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对具有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若是特殊情况，还可能致命……

幸好我们有备而来，校准了引擎来保护自己的灵能天赋者免受这次事件的反噬。
